notes.title: Patch Note v0.31
notes.notes:
⋅ Fixed behavior regarding jumps in 2D and 3D actions.
Fixed a bug in which pressing the jump button would sometimes not result in a jump.
Other specification changes were made to improve operability.
∙ Fixed some text bugs
∙ Fixed a bug in which a miss decision sometimes did not occur even if the user fell.
∙ Changed some UI graphics.
